read_excel: read an Excel file into a DataFrame with configurable engine, sheet, and parsing options
read_excel_multiple_sheets: read multiple Excel sheets into a dictionary of DataFrames by passing a list of sheet names
create_writer_excel: create an ExcelWriter to write DataFrames to xlsx, xls, or ods files with context manager support
create_excel_file: create an ExcelFile object to parse tabular Excel sheets into DataFrame objects
inspect_excel_format: inspect an Excel file's binary content to determine its format (xls, xlsx, xlsb, ods)
